description: Nightly test builds of Madeira. Each build's full source code is attached to its GitHub release.

apps.name: Madeira
apps.subtitle: Windows games on iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription: Windows games on iPhone and iPad. Nightly test build; source code for each build: github.com/camhoc/Madeira/releases
apps.versionDescription:
Madeira Nightly 0.2.101
Everything since 0.2.100. Test build: send a log with Get Help for anything that breaks.

- Controller: claims controller input again if the first try at app start was too early
- Touch mode: a tap moves the pointer first, then clicks
- Left 4 Dead 2: downloaded Workshop add-ons are copied where the game looks for them
- Madeira Dock: games with no .exe launch option use the best non-beta Windows option
- Touch controls: a stick zone can move the mouse
- Touch controls: a stick zone can hold an extra action when pushed far
- Gyro aim: more activation buttons and an on-screen Gyro button
- Touch controls: buttons can latch and press a second key
- Touch controls: button opacity and colour
- Fix for the Visual C++ installer failing in some Unreal games
- Baldur's Gate 3 launcher: room for the fourth Chromium memory pool

Not yet device-tested.

news.title: Madeira Nightly 0.2.101
news.caption: New: touch stick zones can move the mouse and hold an extra action, latching buttons, button opacity and colour, more gyro buttons. Fixes for taps, controller start-up, Left 4 Dead 2 Workshop add-ons, Madeira Dock launch options and the Visual C++ installer in some Unreal games. Not yet device-tested: please send a log with Get Help if something breaks.

news.title: Madeira Nightly 0.2.100
news.caption: New: more of Apple's standard look, no double highlight with controllers on iPad, faster DX12 starts (KosmicKrisp shader cache), Steam launch arguments, finger camera follows sensitivity in Relative mode, better tap-to-click. Raft reaches its menu, L4D2 start fix, Batman reaches the title screen. Known: BG3 and BO3 still close early. Please send a log with Get Help if something breaks.
